defects.title: The method 'mol' stops with Too many input arguments
defects.trigger: addInchiToModel(model, molFileDir, 'mol', 0) with model.mets = {'a[c]';'b[c]'} and an empty folder
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a 2026-11-16: "Too many input arguments." (MATLAB:TooManyInputs) at line 64; which('createInChIStruct','-all') lists only src/analysis/thermo/inchi/old/createInChIStruct.m (inchiStruct = createInChIStruct(mets, sdfFileName)); the 3-input/2-output form exists only in inchi/new, removed from the path
defects.expected: model.inchi and model.molBool built from the mol files in molFileDir

notes: The default 'sdf' method runs the OLD callees on the path: src/analysis/thermo/molFiles/old/mol2sdf.m, then src/analysis/thermo/inchi/old/createInChIStruct.m -> inchi/old/sdf2inchi.m, which runs system('babel ...'); probe: 'babel: command not found' (status 127), error 'Conversion to InChI not successful' at sdf2inchi line 54, so lines 60 and 70-87 need Open Babel (exemption noted in the header). Which callee runs depends on the method argument ('sdf' -> old mol2sdf + old createInChIStruct; 'mol' -> createInChIStruct with the new signature), hence no extra_edges. Code-read, for whoever fixes it: (1) old mol2sdf writes MetStructures.sdf to the CURRENT folder (seen in the probe) but line 60 reads [molFileDir filesep 'MetStructures.sdf']; (2) old mol2sdf line 69 sets noMolMetList = mets WITH a mol file (ismember not negated), so model.molBool at line 55 would be inverted (callee defect in molFiles/old/mol2sdf.m). Repro: initCobraToolbox(false); d=tempname; mkdir(d); addInchiToModel(struct('mets',{{'a[c]';'b[c]'}}), d, 'mol', 0). Caller: createTrainingModel in trainingModel/new (off the path).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: the documented 'mol' method fails with Too many input arguments against the createInChIStruct on the path)
